outline: 介紹數位訊號處理器(digital signal processor，簡稱DSP)基本原理與其應用，以針對本課程配合使用的TMS320F28027做詳細導覽與了解晶片內部結構的規劃，晶片開發實務的技巧，實作DSP課程的理論算法
schedule:
Week1：課程概述
Week2：數位訊號處理晶片簡介
Week3：整合開發環境 CCS
Week4：CCS專案建構與組成
Week5：28027記憶體與CMD文件配置
Week6：計數器與中斷
Week7：Fast fourier transform (FFT)
Week8：Finite impulse response (FIR)
Week9：Infinite impulse response (IIR)
Week10：Kalman filter
Week10：Wavelet transform
Week11 ：GPIO操作及測試
Week12 ：PWM波形產生
Week13 ：馬達控制
Week14 ：A/D轉換
Week15 ：Speech recognition
Week16 ：IMU
Week17 ：Image compression by wavelet
Week18 ：Project report (II)
scorePolicy:
上課參與 10%
實驗報告 60%
期末報告 30%
